title: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”.
when: Opt in to something in a form (accept terms, include archived).

instead.need: A setting that applies at once
Exactly one option of a few

a11y: A real <input type="checkbox">: Space toggles, label clicks toggle, description is linked.
Without a visible label (row selection) give aria-label or aria-labelledby (label wins); in development a checkbox with no name logs a warning.
On touch screens (any coarse pointer) the hit area is 44 × 44 px around the box; the visible size and layout do not change.

examples.title: Row selection without a visible label
